prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: refined photorealistic CYMBA hero cutout with actual transparent background.
INPUT 1 is the composition/edit target. INPUT 2 is a close hardware reference for construction and materials only.
USER'S REQUEST: the earbuds currently look AI-generated; make them look like real premium precision-manufactured earphones photographed by a professional studio. Give the buds convincing physical detail and very crisp clarity.

COMPOSITION IS LOCKED to image 1: preserve the very small distant earbuds near the top, their level mirrored worn orientation with tips inward, their existing head-width spacing, the long thin separate wires that curve closer together toward the bottom, their gradual alpha fade, the generous empty transparent space, and the 4:3 framing. Each earbud remains about 5% of canvas width. Do NOT enlarge the buds or shorten the cables.
Rebuild the earbuds' surface detail and photographic realism, not the layout.

PHOTOGRAPHIC QUALITY:
Render at the highest native resolution available, ideally 4096 by 3072, so the tiny buds contain genuine resolved detail. Tack-sharp focus on both buds, no depth blur. An honest high-end product packshot taken with a long macro lens at f/11, focus stacked, softly lit by large white studio cards. Restrained highlights and accurate local contrast. Rich near-black materials still show their subtle tonal differences. No glowing outlines, no excessive bloom, no waxy surfaces or unreal gloss.

REAL MANUFACTURED DETAILS:
Use the exact hardware design from image 2: compact smoked-charcoal shell, oval satin-black faceplate, thin champagne bezel, plain black silicone support wing, smoke-grey silicone ear tip. Refine construction into clean intentional geometry: a crisp consistent slim machined-metal bezel with tiny brushed-grain highlights, a subtly microtextured matte faceplate, tight even assembly seams, rounded physical edge breaks, properly seated silicone tips with natural soft translucency at their thin edges, a neat cable strain-relief boot, and fine resolved braided cable weave. Subtle controlled smoked shell translucency shows believable simplified structure, never random melted metallic blobs. Materials must each react differently to light: quiet satin aluminum, matte silicone, restrained smoked polymer. Tiny material imperfections may be extremely subtle, with no dirt or damage.
Keep left and right units anatomically mirrored and identically engineered. Avoid artificial decorative greebles, excess rings, invented vents, extra contacts, screws, branding or new hardware. The realism comes from physically consistent construction, precise edges, material separation and beautiful restrained lighting.

Preserve the existing long inward-converging cables and smooth alpha fade. Real transparency everywhere else including between the cables. No white rectangle, no opaque background, no fog, no baked checkerboard, no drop shadow, no surface, no human, no silhouette, no controller, no extra objects, no text or watermark. This should read as a carefully retouched real studio product photograph, not an AI illustration or plastic CGI concept.
web_encoding: Lossless WebP at native output dimensions; Next.js delivery quality 95.
